title: A mathematical study of periodic band inversion
summary: We give a mathematical analysis of the periodic band inversion phenomenon observed by Tan--Devakul for an electron in a two-dimensional periodic potential coupled to a circularly polarized photon cavity mode. In the strong-coupling limit, we derive an effective Bloch Hamiltonian and prove convergence of the low-lying bands. For a cosine potential, we explain the periodic closing and reopening of the first spectral gap, prove the existence and generic persistence of Dirac cones at the gap-closing points, and compute the Chern numbers associated to isolated band clusters.
